narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Twelve tens are one hundred and twenty. The twelve tenths go after the point, so one hundred and twenty point one two.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But twelve tenths is more than ten tenths, so it holds a whole unit.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Only nine tenths fit after the point, so the rest must carry.
